summary: DHT Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 6-K providing notice of the internet availability of proxy materials for its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for June 18, 2026. The agenda includes the election of Jeremy Kramer as a Class I director for a three-year term and ratification of Ernst & Young AS as independent auditor for fiscal year 2026. The board unanimously recommends a vote for both proposals. This is a routine annual meeting notice with no special situation elements such as activist campaigns, strategic changes, or financial restructuring. No deal terms are present.
